thread:
maria (People Ops): Pilot idea / request: small "desk baskets" to surprise contributors during our Q3 sprint wrap. Goal: 75 office baskets + 30 remote parcels. Looking for budget sign-off, packing volunteers, and a brief checklist. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

kevin (Supply): I can source baskets + filler. Quick q: are these branded or neutral? Branded drives cost up.

zara (Design): Recommend neutral kraft basket with 1 branded sticker & a handwritten note. I can print 100 stickers.

maria (People Ops): Neutral is fine. Keep cost target <$11/desk basket incl. items but excl. shipping. Remote parcels can be a $10 e-gift + note.

felix (Finance): OK to approve up to $1,200 from culture budget. Need vendor invoice + vendor tax ID in the sheet before we spend. Also code to GL 4-215.

kevin (Supply): Preliminary kit contents: 
- 1 x mini notebook
- 1 x pen
- 1 x snack pack (GF option)
- 1 x sticker
- 1 x mini desk plant (fake) OR seed packet
- 1 x packing slip
(we can drop plant to hit $11)

maria (People Ops): Let's drop the plant to keep costs down. Substitute seed packet. Add 20 spot-award tokens that we'll insert randomly into select baskets.

zara (Design): I'll draft the packing slip text. Proposal: "Thanks for going the extra mile this quarter — nominate a teammate in #gratitude if they made your day!" Thoughts?

felix (Finance): Wording ok. Internal copy should also include: "Charge to GL 4-215; retain receipts."

anya (Remote Ops): For remote recipients I need name,email,timezone. I'll send e-giftcards in two batches to avoid odd local hours. Please populate sheet col D-F.

maria (People Ops): Added the columns. Volunteers needed: HQ packing on Wed 9-11am (4 people), NYC staging Thurs 3-5pm (3 people). Who can help? @here

kevin (Supply): I'll bring 2 temps + packing tape. Need two more volunteers for HQ.

zara (Design): I can do NYC packing Thurs. Also dropping stickers Wed.

maria (People Ops): Volunteer roster so far: maria, zara, kevin, tasha (People Ops), rafael (Events). Need one more for HQ.

felix (Finance): Please upload the vendor quote to the sheet under "invoices" and cc finance@redwood.com so I can run PO. Also confirm estimated total with shipping.

packing-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Desk-basket packing - Wed 09:00 @HQ" :package:

maria (People Ops): Final ask: can someone proof the packing slip + confirm sticker print quantity (100)? I'll finalize counts by EOD today and lock the vendor. Thanks all :sparkles:
